verdict.rationale: The evidence shows `tofu plan` previews changes and `-out=FILE` saves a plan for a later `tofu apply`. That is a building block someone could use to build a human review step, but it is not an enforced approval gate. Nothing in the pack covers least-privilege credential scoping, policy-as-code enforcement, or any way to stop an agent from applying unapproved changes.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can let an agent plan and apply with least-privilege credentials and review gates so it cannot make unapproved changes
